records.title: Dabeh Shreibman
records.summary: Dabeh Shreibman is listed in the Sokółka necrology index as the wife of Meir Shreibman.

records.title: Shreibman family of Sokółka
records.summary: A provisional family grouping is supported for Meir Shreibman, his wife Dabeh, and their sons Gabriel and Reuben. Dorah and Itzkeh Shreibman should not be included as immediate family members without additional evidence.
